_meta.title: v8p2 reproducible infer-only smoke (costmap Dijkstra progress distance: dijkstra8_nocorner, fixed v7p1 checkpoint)
_meta.summary: Infer-only A/B for v8p2: keep v7p1 checkpoint fixed and switch progress distance to costmap-weighted Dijkstra (8-connected, no corner-cutting) to measure path/time impact without retraining.
commands: conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile repro_20260223_v8p2_costmap_infer_smoke
conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile repro_20260223_v8p2_costmap_infer_smoke --forest-progress-dist-mode euclid
notes: This profile is infer-only (no train section).
Compare dijkstra8_nocorner vs euclid by overriding --forest-progress-dist-mode on the CLI.
Sampling/suite constraints remain Euclidean-based (same as v7p1) to avoid distribution drift.
